# Genesys Cloud Client Logger #

This project is a Bitbucket repository that contains the pipeline infrastructure for the open source [Genesys Cloud Client Logger](git@bitbucket.org:inindca/genesys-cloud-client-logger.git) hosted on GitHub.

### What is this repository for?

Current guidance from security and the CI/CD teams is to not have the pipeline infrastructure available in open source repositories. This repository is used to host the pipeline infrastructure for the Genesys Cloud Client Logger so that we may retain access to the CDN and ability to publish to NPM.

### Contributions

* Leave all source code in the GitHub repository.
* Only pipeline infrastructure should be in this repository.

### Who do I talk to?
